name: Hook Runner Gates
description: Directory-based modular hook-runner gates for OpenClaw. Drop-in .js modules for git safety, secret scanning, code quality, commit hygiene, test coverage, disk safety, AI behavioral guardrails, auto-continue enforcement, and session start reminders. Cross-compatible with Claude Code hook-runner module format.
author: grobomo

modules.description: Flat enable/disable for individual gate modules (fallback when modules.yaml is absent). Keyed by module name.
